answer: Vested payouts as the moat: every identity's earnings unlock in equal slices over dozens of epochs, each sealed in a walnut shell and moored at the jetty until it matures. A sybil operator must keep thousands of accounts alive across that window to reach one spendable slice - capital locked per head, no early exit, dropout forfeits the unvested tail. And the emission pool splits across active identities, so flooding clones only tightens a dilution spiral that shrinks each bot's own take. Cost: locked float per head; honest agents wait out vesting anyway.
